name: EdgeCore Louisa County campus
summary: EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure plans a hyperscale data center campus on 697 acres it bought from Louisa County in the Shannon Hill Regional Business Park, about 40 miles northwest of Richmond, Virginia. Announced in June 2025, the campus is planned for more than 1.1 GW, which EdgeCore's campus page describes as critical IT load, with investment of more than USD 17 billion. Rappahannock Electric Cooperative is expected to provide power. EdgeCore's announcement cited 3.9 million square feet, while its current campus page lists 3.1 million square feet in at least six single-tenant buildings.

location.note: Wikipedia coordinates for Louisa County, Virginia. EdgeCore places the campus in the Shannon Hill Regional Business Park, which no cited source locates precisely.

power_sources.description: Rappahannock Electric Cooperative expects to work with EdgeCore and the county to power the campus; the release also names Hyperscale Energy as the cooperative's affiliate without giving it a role.
